michigan.headline: Michigan CRA recalls Naked Hippie Lucky Berry gummies due to adverse effects
michigan.summary: The Michigan Cannabis Regulatory Agency and The Gummie Joint recalled Naked Hippie Lucky Berry gummies after reports of bad highs and stomach pain.
michigan.impact: Potential supply disruption and increased regulatory scrutiny on edibles.

federal.headline: DEA rejects D.C. medical marijuana registration application
federal.summary: DEA denied a medical marijuana registration application in D.C., highlighting ongoing federal enforcement challenges despite political shifts.
federal.impact: Continued federal enforcement risks and regulatory uncertainty for cannabis businesses.
